description.$value: Min/max width for the page-container component in the Figma library, at the sm (small) viewport. Mode-scoped: resolves to the sm range when the sm viewport mode is active.

min_width.$description: Minimum width of a page container in the current viewport mode. In xs it is the minimum page width the system supports and does not reference the range start (0px).

max_width.$description: Maximum width of a page container in the current viewport mode. The 2xl range is open-ended; its value 99999px is a sentinel, not a real breakpoint.
